rules.statement: The amount of security ordered to be furnished by the judgment debtor should not be unduly excessive and should reasonably safeguard the interests of the judgment creditor in the event of the judgment appealed from being eventually affirmed.
rules.supporting_quote: "The amount of security should be such as would reasonably safeguard the interests of the judgment-Creditor in the event of the judgment appealed from being eventually affirmed in appeal."

meta.parties: Waharaka Sobitha Unnanse v. Amunugama Piyaratana Unnanse
